title: Paul McCartney live: Rose Garden, Portland | 2005
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Rose Garden in Portland, Oregon, USA, on 4 November 2005.

It was the 25th show of the US Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between September and November 2005. This show was seen by 15,834 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at the Rose Garden on 18 October 2002 during the Driving World Tour. He returned for the One On One Tour on 15 April 2016.
